predictions.prediction_text: Markets will be range-bound with negative drift and low volatility, producing spot decay similar to February but stretched in time.
predictions.expected_result: Price will trade sideways within a narrowing range while gradually trending downward, with realized volatility lower than recent averages over the coming weeks.

predictions.prediction_text: A bearish wedge or pennant will form with its apex around the April 9–10 highs.
predictions.expected_result: Price structure will exhibit converging highs and lows forming a wedge/pennant pattern that culminates near the April 9–10 high levels before resolving.

predictions.prediction_text: Centroid lies in the 5316.62 - 5337.94 area with more weight at the upper bound.
predictions.expected_result: Price will gravitate toward and spend increased time in the 5316.62–5337.94 range, especially near 5337.94.

predictions.prediction_text: The downside pivot is 5276.96 where price will free from the iron-condor effect.
predictions.expected_result: After breaking below 5276.96, price will accelerate downward and no longer be constrained by the prior range-bound / IC-induced resistance.

predictions.prediction_text: The upside pivot is 5421.59 where volatility should decrease if price wants to reject the upper wing of the iron-condor.
predictions.expected_result: If price nears 5421.59 and volatility falls, price will be rejected and reverse back into the range rather than break out higher.

predictions.prediction_text: If volatility calms on both sides, expect rangebound behavior around 5366.89 (near the zero vanna line).
predictions.expected_result: Price will consolidate around 5366.89 with reduced intraday movement and low realized volatility.

predictions.prediction_text: 5285/5290 and 5445/5450 act as significant resistance (short iron-condor wings) and are pin potential.
predictions.expected_result: Price will be resisted when approaching 5285–5290 on the downside and 5445–5450 on the upside, increasing the likelihood of expiration pinning near these strikes.

predictions.prediction_text: Traders will short vega and delta into May options expiration.
predictions.expected_result: Open interest and positioning will show net short vega and short delta exposure into May expiry, increasing option-implied skew and sensitivity to volatility declines.
